summary: CardWheelModePage.ets: Circle decorations changed from regular Stack children (taking layout space via explicit width/height) to absolutely positioned elements using .position(). Circles now at y:-190 and y:-112 (partially off-screen, showing only bottom arc). Spacings reduced: title margin-top 16→12, subtitle margin-top 12→4, subtitle margin-bottom 24→16, ASTRO WHEEL margin-bottom 16→12. Total effective upward shift: ~96vp (spacing) + circle visual removal (~100vp perception).
